TaskDescription: Random (baseline) condition: the 6 repeating scene images presented in random temporal order. Each image 250 ms, then 250 ms inter-stimulus interval.
Instructions: Participants passively viewed a rapid stream of scene images and were asked to pay attention to each image. They were not told the names of the scenes or scene categories (Sherman et al. 2023, Methods, Procedure).
iEEGReference: Signals were referenced to an electrode chosen by the clinical team to minimize noise in the recording (Dryad methods).
iEEGPlacementScheme: Clinically determined implant (Sherman et al. 2023: 'Electrode placement was determined solely by the clinical care team to localize seizure foci'). Table 1: implant type combined (depth electrodes plus subdural grid/strip electrodes); hemisphere: primarily right; 217 contacts.

StimulusPresentation.SoftwareName: MATLAB (The MathWorks) with the Psychophysics Toolbox; experiment run on a laptop while the participant was seated in the hospital bed (Sherman et al. 2023, Methods, Stimuli and Procedure)
